versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the World Bank Open Data skill for agents.
- Retrieve, interpret, and cite World Bank annual indicators across countries with no API key required.
- Supports searching indicators, confirming metadata, fetching time series, resolving country codes, and exploring topics.
- Clear rules for when to use or not use, citation, and numeric integrity (handle `null` as missing).
- Includes step-by-step workflows, error handling guidance, and checklist for correct data use.
